additional_info.subject: ID0424086-DC/Si-D/BE- [MP / R4 170001921] dispenser Warning CRM:02698000137
additional_info.body:
Hi Chloë, good morning.
I've checked all the session from the 3rd May until 13th May 23:59 and here are my findings, please be aware of the time difference, it should match your time +2h:
3rd May - working session:
After this, the sessions runs smoothly.
On the 5th May - 2 failed sessions:
6th May - 2 failed sessions:
2025-05-06T13:01:08.306Z - no authentication provided - DC3
2025-05-06T13:42:10.479Z - no authentication provided - DC3
2025-05-06T14:58:01.263Z - no authentication provided - DC3
13th May - some failed session due to no authentication provided and 1 successfull session:
Here I don't have the message "Authenticated 2" not sure why the system didn't write that log but I can still confirm that it must be there because when the session works we get the same message for the next steps:
“precharge 2”.
I believe everything is working as it should. My ideas are:
For the authentication not provided, it's possible that the customer tried with Credit card but the Terminal is not initialised, making it impossible to start
For the wrong connector selection, is it possible that the IDs are not intuitive and the customer is choosing the wrong one?
If you want and are able to, we can schedule a remote session and test all the outlets properly and confirm our suspicions.
What do you think?
Regarding the Selftest:
The self-test is performed at each boot-up of the dispenser where the cooling fans are power-cycled on-off from dispenser-PLC for multiple times in short duration cycles. If the ok signal reported by fan is lost even after a delay of ON command to the fan, it denotes self test error
This just means that the fan signal was lost shortly. I've never seen this error flag cause any problem. Usually this error is recovered after a reboot.
I will wait for your feedback.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
